interpretation: A positive normalized Gaussian cloud scale fitted from development MTF alone predicts disjoint-frequency MTF and independent realized Poisson NPS shape for every frozen layer and density.

The result validates a joint mechanism contract, not the Gaussian profile or any radius for real film. It neither measures a stock/process/scanner nor authorizes photographic rendering or product integration.
